children: shares fell 9.49% to $138.88 at 9:35 a.m. ET on Friday, November 6, after the blood-test cancer diagnostics company raised its full-year free cash flow burn outlook to $205 million to $220 million from $195 million to $205 million. Revenue beat was not enough. The spending bill got bigger.

Third-quarter revenue rose 36% to $361 million. Screening revenue jumped 180% to $67.6 million as Shield test volume hit 83,000, and oncology volume grew 58%. Guardant lifted 2026 revenue guidance to $1.36 billion to $1.37 billion and Shield revenue to $233 million to $238 million. But non-GAAP operating expenses are now expected at $1.105 billion to $1.125 billion, up from the prior range, and the quarter's GAAP net loss widened to $124.4 million.

The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 68/100, with Momentum the best spoke, while Profitability and GF Value are weak and Financial Strength middling. Shares trade about twice a GF Value of $68.54, and the market value is roughly 13.7 times the 2026 revenue guide. With $1.1 billion of cash, Guardant has runway; the test is whether Shield scale lowers the burn in 2027.

title: Guardant Health Stocks Fall 9.49% as Cash Burn Outlook Rises Despite 36% Growth
